========================================
Bare pointer type as a call argument
========================================

int g(void) {
  SWAP(void *, &a, &b);
  SWAP(const char *, &a, &b);
  return 0;
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type))))
    body: (compound_statement
      (macro_declaration
        (identifier)
        (macro_argument_list
          (primitive_type)
          (pointer_expression
            argument: (identifier))
          (pointer_expression
            argument: (identifier))))
      (macro_declaration
        (identifier)
        (macro_argument_list
          (primitive_type)
          (pointer_expression
            argument: (identifier))
          (pointer_expression
            argument: (identifier))))
      (return_statement
        (number_literal)))))

========================================
Multi-word and struct types as call arguments
========================================

int g(void) {
  SWAP(unsigned int, a, b);
  SWAP(struct foo *, &a, &b);
  return 0;
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type))))
    body: (compound_statement
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (argument_list
            (identifier)
            (primitive_type)
            (identifier)
            (identifier))))
      (macro_declaration
        (identifier)
        (macro_argument_list
          (identifier)
          (identifier)
          (pointer_expression
            argument: (identifier))
          (pointer_expression
            argument: (identifier))))
      (return_statement
        (number_literal)))))
